bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · testing the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 测试 100 日均线

read.en: Nvidia fell 1.8% on Oct 15 to $217.23 after trading as low as $212.85. It is below its falling 5-day ($224.5) and 10-day ($230.3) averages and the 30-day ($225.8), and above the rising 100-day ($214.5) and 200-day ($202.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is still above zero with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($242.0), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月15日下跌 1.8%，收于 $217.23，盘中最低下探 $212.85。股价位于下行的 5 日（$224.5）和 10 日均线（$230.3）以及 30 日均线（$225.8）下方，并在上行的 100 日（$214.5）和 200 日均线（$202.8）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$242.0），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The day's low dipped under the $214.5 support (100-day average, tested five times since April), but the close held above it. The Oct 14 low ($219.6) is now first resistance, then $224.5–225.8 (5 and 30-day averages) and $230.3 (10-day). Support is $214.5, then $207–209 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows) and $202.8 (200-day). A close below $212.9 would open $207–209.
read.zh: 当日低点跌破 $214.5 支撑（100 日均线，4月以来五次测试），但收盘守在其上方。10月14日低点（$219.6）现为第一阻力，其次 $224.5–225.8（5 日和 30 日均线）和 $230.3（10 日均线）。支撑为 $214.5，其次 $207–209（8月24日及 9月14日低点）和 $202.8（200 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $212.9，将打开至 $207–209 的空间。

s.en: 100-day average; tested five times since April
